about: [helmet plan, stage 1] A player's helmet paint (Profile page > HELMET; FTorqueProfile's colour and finish), put on the Fab helmet's shell by TorqueHelmetLook::ApplyPaint (Source/TorqueShedProto/RiderRig.cpp) with Tools/ue_build_level.py's masters /Game/Rider/Materials/M_HelmetPaint_Coat (clear coat) and M_HelmetPaint_Plain. The shell is the slots in 'paint_slots' (numbers, once the PC's helmet export shows them), or else every slot whose slot or material name has a 'paint_words' word and no 'keep_words' word. Each slot it touches is logged ('Torque: helmet slot N (...) painted ...'). 'finishes' are in the Profile page's order: gloss, matt, metallic, pearl; 'pearl' is how far the colour turns to a lighter, hue-shifted tint at grazing angles.
